title: BYD shows Mako hybrid pickup and stirs up the Brazilian market
seoTitle: BYD Mako Hybrid Pickup: New Model Revealed in Brazil
subtitle: Electrified model arrives to compete in the intermediate pickup segment and will be manufactured in Bahia.
excerpt: BYD presented the Mako hybrid pickup in Interlagos, generating great curiosity in the automotive sector and news for the national market.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The official presentation of the Mako hybrid pickup by BYD in Interlagos caught the attention of the Brazilian automotive sector and placed the model among the most searched topics. The vehicle was displayed wrapped in yellow, just days after the revelation of the Volkswagen Tukan in the same color, generating comments about the chosen look.

The national project and production in Camaçari

The Mako pickup is part of a project developed especially for the Brazilian market and will be manufactured in Camaçari, Bahia. The model's arrival at dealerships is scheduled for the end of this year, with the objective of expanding the manufacturer's national portfolio and betting on electrification and competitive prices.

Hybrid motorization and track performance

Mako's mechanical set is a plug-in flex hybrid, combining an electric motor with a combustion engine that runs on gasoline or ethanol. During tests carried out at the racetrack, the dashboard indicated combined autonomy, and the mechanical set showed similarities to the one used in the Song Pro SUV, prioritizing urban comfort and continuous performance.

Direct competition with established models

The new pickup arrives to compete in a crowded segment, with direct rivals including the Fiat Toro, RAM Rampage, and the upcoming Volkswagen Tukan. With dimensions and a price range projected to target this market, Mako seeks to win over consumers looking for electrified options in the category.

Prototype details and next steps

The model displayed in São Paulo is still in the prototype stage, which means the final paint job was hidden under stickers and definitive technical data may still undergo adjustments until the official launch. The steering presented characteristics that raised questions during tests, but the urban-tuned suspension received positive reviews.

With information from G1, Motor1.com Brazil, CNN Brazil.
